title.narrative: Strengthened labour administration system for more effective labour market governance, improved working conditions and compliance

description.narrative: Labour inspection is a key element of any labour administration system for enduring the implementation of labour policies, providing feedback and allowing for a readjustment of these policies as necessary. In recent years, the importance of labour inspection in promoting decent work has been widely recognized. Yet in many countries, the changing world of work with its new employment patterns has been accompanied by reduced government interventions in the workplace. Even where there is a general agreement on the benefits of labour inspection, the real impact of labour inspectors has often been limited, especially among vulnerable or hard-to-reach groups and in the large informal economy. The ILO through this CPO is working to strengthen the labour inspection systems in Zambia with a view to ensuring labour law compliance through the promotion of relevant international labour standards, and technical advisory services and projects. Labour Administration For Zambia to domesticate the conventions highlighted above and address the labour market challenges it is facing, the ILO will need to provide support for the following areas which have been prioritised by the country: Labour Law Reforms With the support of the ILO, Zambia has been carrying out a labour law reform process. The process has scored some success, notably with the Employment (Amendment) Act No. 15 of 2015. The revised Act defined employment relationships which were not clearly defined in the past and these included casual employment, fixed term contracts, seasonal employment, short-term contracts, temporal employment and part-time work. The ILO is currently providing technical support in the total overhaul and consolidation of different pierces of labour legislation. This support has resulted in the development of the Labour Bill which is yet to be finalised and submitted to Parliament for adoption.
